# ARCH-12: Memory is paid for only where it is used

An optional feature allocates its state at init or on first use, only when the hardware or the feature is present. Check every allocation, report a failure rather than skip it in silence, and make every path that uses the object cope with it being absent. Free what an option stops using and clear the pointer, and keep large buffers out of BSS, which on some boards shares a full first memory block with the vehicle objects (tridge, [#13923](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/pull/13923), [#11795](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/pull/11795)).

Confirmed 2026-10-16. Part of the root playbook, under [Development Constraints](../claude/CLAUDE.md#development-constraints). [All architectural rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
